authorityBoundary.allowedLocatorOptimization: package or bundle filtering may reduce search work, but cannot establish semantic identity or absence
authorityBoundary.proofRule: official installer package -> ZIP entry -> Unity bundle -> normalized runtime container path exact match -> at least one Sprite exact hit -> Sprite decode

classifications.VERIFIED: one or more exact normalized runtime-path Sprite hits decode with non-empty alpha and all Sprite exact hits are render-equivalent; exact-path non-Sprite companion objects are recorded but do not invalidate valid Sprite proof
classifications.NOT_IN_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT: no exact hit after successful exhaustive package discovery and exhaustive bundle coverage for the source snapshot
classifications.REVIEW: no exact hit under non-exhaustive locator filtering; absence is not proven
classifications.BLOCKER: the official source could not be searched, no Sprite exists among observed exact-path objects, or Sprite exact hits could not be safely decoded/validated

runtimeEvidenceMaintenance.reason: Skill2_ABS and Item05_ABS canaries expose Texture2D and Sprite companion objects under the same exact runtime container path
runtimeEvidenceMaintenance.effect: non-Sprite companions no longer block when at least one valid Sprite exact hit exists

absenceRule: NOT_IN_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT is allowed only when searchCoverage is EXHAUSTIVE_ALL_BUNDLES and no source-read/decode gap remains.
mutationPolicy: read-only; verifier must not modify tracked repository files
